AN356
Applied Anthropology and Activism
0.5 Credit
This
course
examines how cultural anthropologists apply their theories, methods and insights to the solution of practical problems. The historical development of applied anthropology, the ethical dilemmas of applied fieldwork and the research methods used in such fieldwork will be examined. Such areas of
concentration
as community development, advocacy anthropology, policy research and social impact assessment are investigated.
Additional Course Information
Prerequisites
Registration Status: Year 3 or Year 4
Exclusions
